basic_info.description: Enjoy comfortable city living in this 2-level townhouse at Opera Plaza, located in SF's Civic Center District. This corner unit offers a unique blend of convenience & a direct connection to the city's cultural scene. The open-concept main level features upgraded wood flooring, a kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances & fireplace. Two outdoor spaces include a balcony off the kitchen & an enclosed patio entrance welcoming you into the unit. Large windows & sliding doors bring in abundant natural light & provide views of the landscaped courtyard & common are pool & spa. Upstairs, two bedrooms with new carpeting provide a quiet living space each with their own bath with upgraded TOTO washlet toilets. Residents have access to Opera Plaza's extensive amenities, including 24-hour security & door person, a concierge, a heated lap pool, spa, fitness center, racquetball courts, & sauna. Parking is available for lease at $260/mo in the building's garage & hourly paid valet parking is available for guests. Situated on the Van Ness corridor, this home is just minutes from the Opera House, Symphony, Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, Orpheum Theatre, SFJAZZ, & the popular shops & restaurants of Hayes Valley. HOA dues include earthquake insurance, on-site management, & high-speed internet!
